day_shape: 78 items: IRGC says two tankers seized in Strait of Hormuz with Brent reported above $116, Qatari delegation lands in Tehran as Vance reportedly offers to meet Rezaei, State Dept posts fresh SDN designations, Pentagon planner Sylvia fired over Iran/Ukraine leaks.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker seizures
threads.summary: The IRGC Navy said two oil tankers were stopped in southern waters of the Strait of Hormuz after allegedly taking an unauthorised route, confirmed via Jerusalem Post. A separate vessel caught fire northeast of Oman, and Defa Press reported Brent crude above $116–117 per barrel.

threads.label: Qatar mediation and Vance-Rezaei track
threads.summary: A Qatari delegation led by the senior adviser to Qatar's PM arrived in Tehran, as Iran International reported Vice President JD Vance offered to meet Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei. Trump said Vance's letter concerned medical supplies; Tasnim confirmed receipt without reply, and Tehran's Friday prayer leader rejected US overtures.

threads.label: US military posture and Pentagon leak firing
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Defense Secretary Hegseth fired Lt. Gen. Brett Sylvia after he admitted leaking classified Iran and Ukraine information, while CENTCOM chief Adm. Brad Cooper briefed Trump on military options. Treasury Secretary Bessent said Iran cannot pay its troops due to Operation Economic Outcast, and the State Department published new SDN designations.

threads.label: Yemen, Saudi and Lebanon flashpoints
threads.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a Houthi drone over the Mecca region, which Yemen's armed forces spokesperson denied, while Houthis claimed strikes on three Saudi oil facilities and two airports. Jerusalem Post reported Trump pledged a full IDF withdrawal from Lebanon if Beirut joins the Abraham Accords, and four Lebanese ministers boycotted Cabinet over Hezbollah's explosives file.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging and regime medal ceremony
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted messages and video from a 'Patriotic Medal-Bearers' event where over 200 scientific and sports medals were presented to the Supreme Leader, alongside a statement calling for 'doubled work and innovation'. Defa Press circulated commentary on US domestic politics and claims of 23 US personnel killed in the war with Iran.

threads.label: Israeli election read-across and Iran espionage case
threads.summary: Iran International and a Ghalibaf-linked daily argued Netanyahu's possible exit would not alter Israeli policy toward Tehran, while Jerusalem Post analysed regional views on the vote. An Israeli soldier was charged with espionage for Iran in exchange for cryptocurrency following a Shin Bet-led investigation.

threads.label: Domestic repression and sanctions evasion
threads.summary: Iran International reported a Baha'i photojournalist denied appeal against a 26-year sentence, a new Baha'i prison memoir by Mahvash Sabet, and a cleric sentenced to death twice including for apostasy. A Reuters investigation cited by Iran International said Iran imported at least $2 billion in military supplies via over 5,000 front agencies since January 2025.
